1.explanation: FormGroup.js is the component that renders a <fieldset> and <legend> for arbitrary child form controls. It spreads any extra props only onto the fieldset and does not accept a legendId prop or allow custom attributes on the legend, so you cannot assign an id to the legend. RadioButtonGroup.js likewise renders its own <fieldset> and <legend> but provides no way to pass a custom id to the legend or aria-labelledby to the fieldset. Both files need to be updated to accept legendId and aria-labelledby props (or similar) and apply them respectively to the legend and fieldset to satisfy the a11y requirements described in the bug report.
1.bug_scenario: In the screenshot you can see a <fieldset> element wrapping a group of radio buttons. The fieldset has an aria-labelledby attribute set to "row-height-label", but the <legend> element inside does not support receiving a custom id (legendId) so that the aria-labelledby can point at it. As a result we cannot hook up the fieldset’s aria-labelledby to the legend’s id, which is required for proper screen reader support.
